subject: knitr + Django + Heroku = dynamic reports on the web

messages.author: c56bd87aed67dee4
messages.subject: knitr + Django + Heroku = dynamic reports on the web
parts:
Dear knitrs,

I've built a proof of concept to show how knitr can be used to serve dynamic web reports. The demo is [here](http://dimagi.herokuapp.com/) (note: I'm using Heroku's free option so the server is a little sluggish). I used Django instead of shiny because I'm more comfortable with Django. Looking at the docs for shiny I couldn't figure out how to serve multiple reports. The code for the project is on [GitHub](https://github.com/amarder/reporter). Right now the R Markdown files are stored [in the repo](https://github.com/amarder/reporter/tree/master/compiler/templates) and the config file that defines what parameters a report accepts is [here](https://github.com/amarder/reporter/blob/master/web_portal/portal/reports.json). If you have any comments or questions, I'd love to hear them.

Andrew
